brief:
Palestinians held funeral processions Wednesday for dozens of martyrs in Nuseirat refugee camp, the Ma'an news agency reported. The burials followed recovery operations in the Gaza Strip camp as the territory continues to grapple with mass casualties from ongoing conflict.

Large crowds gathered to mourn those killed, reflecting the scale of loss affecting the densely populated camp in central Gaza.
title: Palestinians bury dozens of dead from Nuseirat camp
